environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following configuration: (1) A custom rule with priority 1 that inspects the request header 'Origin' and 'Referer' — if the request method is POST and neither header value starts with 'https://app.internal.corp.example.com', the rule action is BLOCK with a 403 response. The rule uses a regex pattern set matching '^https://app\.internal\.corp\.example\.com(/|$)'. (2) The application is served exclusively at https://app.internal.corp.example.com via Route53 private hosted zone, accessible only through the corporate VPN (VPC endpoint with security group restricting ingress to 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR). (3) The ALB security group allows inbound HTTPS only from the VPN endpoint ENIs. Cross-origin POST requests from attacker-controlled domains are blocked at the WAF layer before reaching the application.

config.network_access: VPN-only via VPC endpoint, SG restricts to 10.0.0.0/8
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, app.internal.corp.example.com resolves only within VPC
config.alb_security_group: inbound 443 from VPN endpoint ENIs only
